question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abate"** means to become less intense or widespread. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The storm began to abate after a few hours.
 
 
 
• **"Intensify" **refers to something that becomes or makes more intense or severe. (तीव्र करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The heatwave is expected to intensify over the next few days.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abate'** is **'Intensify'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consume **(खपत करना): To use up a resource.
 
 
• **Example:** The new car consumes less fuel.
 
 
 
• **Reduce **(कम करना): To make smaller or less in amount.
 
 
• **Example: **We need to reduce our expenses this month.
 
 
 
• **Supply** (आपूर्ति): To make something available to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The company supplies water to the entire region.
